capability.summary: Coding-agent model emphasizing recovery across extended tool interactions.
capability.problem_space: Coding model for repository editing and development tools. Applicable tasks include repository code editing, debugging, refactoring, test implementation, tool-assisted programming. Accepts text input and produces text output. External tools are required to execute programs, browse sources, or modify files; generated instructions alone do not perform those actions. Published distinction: The documented architecture has 80 billion total and 3 billion active parameters with a hybrid attention layout. Training emphasizes extended tool interactions and recovery after execution failures; tools still execute outside the model.

env_requirements: Valid API Key (Cloud) or High-Memory GPU
constraint.io_signature: Input modalities: text | Output modalities: text. Gateway transport support requires verification.
